svg.title: A feature request becomes a reviewed pull request
svg.desc: The requested outcome authorizes scoped feature work. Maintain its spec and plan, follow actual dependencies, implement directly or delegate useful units, and report observed checks. Real user stops, host permissions, security controls and delivery authority remain effective. Actual endpoint: An open PR, its source identity and observed check state. Merging and publishing remain separate decisions. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Definition → implementation and checks → progress → PR handoff

svg.title: Define the change
svg.desc: command: /ca:feature → skill: brainstorming → skill: writing-plans → skill: executing-plans. A maintained specification and linked plan with observable criteria, actual dependencies and unresolved choices kept visible.

path.title: full lane: New full-lane work enters brainstorming.
criteria: Return the selected specification and actual open decisions directly to planning.
ready plan: The coordinator receives the maintained plan and selects useful authorized work.

g.title: /ca:feature. Resolve existing work before classifying a new request. Resume its actual unfinished step and preserve the selected representation.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: brainstorming. Refine the agreed outcome into observable criteria and exclusions. Ask about consequential unresolved choices while retaining decisions already made.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: writing-plans. Describe coherent tasks, relevant paths, actual dependencies and checks under existing authorization. Maintain in-scope methods with a reason and preserve source identity.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: executing-plans. Select meaningful work using actual task dependencies. Preserve blocked members and authored scope while allowing independent work to continue.

svg.text: Continue ↓ Build and verify each task

svg.title: Build and verify each task
svg.desc: skill: subagent-driven-development: select → agent: Optional backend, frontend or infrastructure author → skill: tdd: select and prove the approach → skill: subagent-driven-development: verify. Implemented work with actual check results and pending verification, returned to the caller.

path.title: implement: Implement directly or assign a useful bounded unit; delegation is conditional.
verify approach: The implementer follows the verification approach suited to the assigned work.
return: Return actual results so the caller can assess criteria, source applicability and remaining work.

g.title: subagent-driven-development: select. Inspect the selected scope, criteria, actual dependencies and current work. Engine eligibility is advisory; inspect outstanding workers before redispatch after interruption.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: Optional backend, frontend or infrastructure author. Choose direct implementation for focused work. Delegate when isolation, parallel work or expertise helps, supplying bounded relevant context. A delivery receipt does not grant execution permission.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: tdd: select and prove the approach. Use genuine regression RED/GREEN for confirmed fixes, criterion-focused feature checks and passing characterization baselines for refactors. Non-executable changes use relevant validation.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: subagent-driven-development: verify. Compare the result with criteria and run applicable checks. Record commands, working directories, outcomes and limitations. Reuse evidence only while its checked source and inputs remain applicable.

svg.title: Review and report progress
svg.desc: agent: Risk-selected reviewers → agent: finding-triage → skill: subagent-driven-development: record progress → skill: executing-plans: report and continue. Current implementation progress, applicable review and check results, and the next authorized work.

path.title: findings: When independent reviewers are dispatched, aggregate their complete findings and unit outcomes.
results: Return applicable review results; implementation status must not conceal failures or missing checks.
to caller: The scoped invocation returns to its coordinator with work and evidence, not directly to commit.

g.title: Risk-selected reviewers. Review the combined relevant diff when risk or policy requires it. Use specialist reviewers for applicable security, dependency or migration concerns and avoid duplicate per-task reviewer cascades.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: finding-triage. Route a dispatched review batch through finding triage and verdict aggregation. Preserve blockers, incomplete units and out-of-scope findings without inventing a successful review.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: subagent-driven-development: record progress. Use the selected writer to record completed implementation. HTML accept-scope can record DONE without a receipt; it cannot clear pending or blocked members. Keep verification and independent acceptance distinct.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: executing-plans: report and continue. Report changes, checks and next work, then continue within existing authorization. Honor a user-requested pause, consequential decision, or actual host/security restriction for the affected work.

svg.title: Commit and open the PR
svg.desc: skill: commit-gate → skill: finishing-a-development-branch → command: /ca:pr procedure, reused by finishing → agent: PR reviewers, finding-triage and verdict-aggregator. An authorized open PR with its current source and observed checks. Merge and publication remain separate actions.

path.title: committed: The branch-finishing owner checks current-head readiness and the selected delivery action.
reuse: Execute the PR contract in place; do not re-invoke its command.
review: PR creation includes its own path-selected review and verdict.

g.title: commit-gate. Use the commit owner only when committing is authorized. It checks the selected staged work, applicable tests, secrets and specialized controls, with fresh behavioral proof.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: finishing-a-development-branch. Retain an existing open-PR choice. Ask for branch disposition only if it is unclear. Merge and discard require their own explicit authorization and applicable evidence.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: /ca:pr procedure, reused by finishing. Finishing executes the PR procedure in place; the command is not re-invoked. For a committed branch, verify the explicit base-to-HEAD subject, including secrets and specialized checks, without creating another commit.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace

g.title: PR reviewers, finding-triage and verdict-aggregator. Apply the PR path matrix and review funnel, including security review for CI/deployment/infrastructure changes. Resolve blockers and report the PR URL, current head and observed checks.
